Why SwitchDev? SwitchDev is a Linux kernel driver that enables you to control switching silicons (ASICs) on a kernel level, using standard open Linux interfaces. Implementing SwitchDev helps to break the vendor lock-in of proprietary SDKs (Software Development Kits), eliminating the dependency on vendor-specific APIs to manage network hardware. It also simplifies integration, setup, and support for new devices through interface unification, in addition to eliminating the need for additional re-training of personnel with each new product. Open Broadband Network Gateway (OpenBNG), leveraging disaggregated solutions, empowers telco operators with the freedom to choose their preferred hardware and software combinations. This increasingly popular approach addresses key challenges by promoting innovation, offering scalability, and reducing operational costs. Download white paper White Paper Abstract SONiC (Software for Open Networking in the Cloud) is an open-source network operating system that started inside Microsoft for Azure and is now managed by the Linux Foundation. It separates network software from the hardware underneath, so you choose switches and silicon independently of the NOS.
